ns2:course.label: Seminar in Chinese Art
ns2:course.description: Investigation of selected phases, concepts, and problems of the art of China; intensive reading and reports. Same as EALC 501. May be repeated to a maximum of 12 hours. Prerequisite: ARTH 401 or consent of instructor.
